description:
<!-- Modified by lavinhoque33, 2026-11-26. -->
## YouTube

- **Watch Later on feed cards (#97):** The clock lines up with the like-count and duration badges in both Cards layouts. Tap to save to Watch Later; hold to open the playlist picker.
- **Home Notifications (#96):** Home can show a bell when YouTube omits it and Notifications is not visible in the bottom bar. It opens the native inbox and respects **Toolbar → Hide Notifications button**. To swap the bottom slot, select **Create** or **Notifications** in **Navigation bar items**. Available on 21.13.164, 21.39.525, and 21.45.90.
- **Glass menus (#89):** The RVX video-quality shortcut and the main Gear menu in landscape fullscreen use frosted glass. Opening a frosted menu no longer shifts the playing picture.

## YouTube Music

- **Light theme (#90):** Fixed contrast in Home and Now Playing menus, native Share actions, Comments, Speed Dial titles, and the RVX Settings icon. The enhanced Lyrics title bar matches the sheet when it first opens. Select **Light** in **RVX → General → App theme** on supported versions from 8.12 onward.

## Both apps

- **Reseam branding (#77):** The optional pack adds a themed launcher icon, a mark beside the native header, and a media notification icon. Turn on **Use icon in RVX settings** for the matching Settings glyph. Stock remains the default.

This build also includes the YouTube **Account switcher shortcut** (#91) and **Ghost mode** (#92) from v1.53.0-dev.1.

This is a patches prerelease. Enable prereleases for the existing RVX Manager source, refresh, and repatch. Stable stays on **v1.52.0**.
